name: agent-inbox
title: Agent Inbox
description: Subscribe to Claude Code and Codex sessions, get notified when they need your input, and jump back to the conversation.
author: silencerichard

commands.name: subscribe-current
commands.title: Subscribe to Current Conversation
commands.subtitle: Agent Inbox
commands.description: Subscribe to the Claude Code or Codex conversation in the focused desktop window or terminal tab.

commands.name: all-sessions
commands.title: All Sessions
commands.subtitle: Agent Inbox
commands.description: Find and subscribe to Claude Code and Codex sessions, including past conversations.

commands.name: inbox
commands.title: Subscriptions
commands.subtitle: Agent Inbox
commands.description: Follow subscribed sessions and jump back to conversations that need your input.

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Session Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: Agent Inbox
commands.description: Show subscribed sessions and the waiting count in the menu bar.

preferences.name: resumeTerminal
preferences.title: Default Terminal
preferences.description: Focus the original session when possible; otherwise resume in the selected terminal.

preferences.name: notifications
preferences.title: System Notifications
preferences.label: Notify when a subscribed session needs attention
preferences.description: Only unhandled requests in subscribed sessions trigger a notification. Open a command after changing this preference to sync the background collector.

preferences.name: contentSearchEnabled
preferences.title: Full-Text Search
preferences.label: Index local conversation content
preferences.description: Read user and agent messages and build a search index on this Mac. Nothing is uploaded. Turning this off stops indexing and queries without deleting the existing index.

scripts.build: npm run build:cli && ray build -e dist
scripts.bundle: npm run build:cli && ray bundle --output dist/agent-inbox.rayext && zip -q -d dist/agent-inbox.rayext '*.map'
scripts.lint:code: eslint src cli test && prettier --check src cli test
scripts.check: npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run lint:code && npm run build
